_about: Cornelius Mathews's The Indian Fairy Book: From the Original Legends (1869), Native American tales retold. The schoolcraft shelf holds a 1916 Stokes printing under the same title whose title page reads "By Henry R. Schoolcraft" (Gutenberg 48469); a quarter of each book's paragraphs are word-for-word in the other, so both are kept as a partial overlap and the shared passages mint once. Which name the collection belongs under is Adam's call (DIGEST-D). Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
